_comment: The Wave Ledger (Steve 2026-10-10): wave unlocks run on KILLS only — a per-wave, per-village, per-run point ledger, cumulative across player deaths. Kill = pointsPerKill. A kill executed with the monster's discovered counter = pointsPerCounterKill (mastery bonus; the counter convention lives in src/js/waveLedger.js — no monster def carries counter data yet, so the bonus is dormant: kills always score at least 1, never less). Per monster-type cap perTypeCap stops farming one type: breadth, not throughput. barsPerWave = point thresholds the ledger for wave N must reach to unlock wave N+1 (the pacing dial Steve will turn). Day floors: wave 2 needs wave2DayFloor, waves 3+ need dayFloor. Scale gates live in code (w4 regional, w5 national) — unchanged.
